title: Git history record schemas
responsibility: Defines the refs and validated note, evidence and legacy record formats used by Git-backed history.

outputs.name: evidenceBranch
outputs.description: The branch name used for the evidence branch in Git-backed history. Its fixed literal is `harness-evidence`.

outputs.name: evidenceRef
outputs.description: The full Git ref for the evidence branch. It points to `refs/heads/harness-evidence`.

outputs.name: notesRef
outputs.description: The Git notes ref name used for history notes. Its fixed value is `refs/notes/harness`.

outputs.name: sourceArchivePrefix
outputs.description: The prefix for source archive refs, with one ref per tested commit named by its hash so the commit outlives its branch. The fixed prefix is `refs/harness/source/`.

outputs.name: remoteTrackingPrefix
outputs.description: The prefix where fetched copies of a remote's evidence and notes are kept before they are merged. Its fixed value is `refs/harness/remotes/`.

outputs.name: evidenceMarker
outputs.description: The filename at the root of every evidence tree. A commit carrying this marker is never treated as source; the value is `harness-evidence.json`.

outputs.name: recordsDirectory
outputs.description: The directory name for stored evidence records. Its fixed value is `records`.

outputs.name: legacyDirectory
outputs.description: The directory name for legacy reports. Its fixed value is `legacy`.

outputs.name: evidencePointerSchema
outputs.description: A strict schema for a stored-record pointer with a full lowercase 40-character commit hash, a nonempty path, and a lowercase 64-character manifest SHA-256 digest. It identifies the evidence commit, record path, and manifest hash; it does not enumerate files.

outputs.name: historyNoteSchema
outputs.description: A strict version 1 discriminated union for the `verification`, `reason`, `legacy-report`, and `regression` history-note kinds. Use it for one line on a source commit; each kind names the commit it was written for and rejects undeclared fields.

outputs.name: evidenceFileSchema
outputs.description: A strict schema for one stored record file: it requires a nonempty path, lowercase 64-character SHA-256, nonnegative integer byte count, and `git` or `lfs` storage, with optional `mediaType`. `git` means an ordinary Git blob; `lfs` means a Git LFS pointer on the branch, and the schema carries no file bytes.

outputs.name: evidenceManifestSchema
outputs.description: The immutable strict schema for a version 1 evidence manifest beside a stored record. It requires a nonempty record name, source commit and tree, pass/fail status, and file list; each source hash is a full commit hash.

outputs.name: legacyRecordSchema
outputs.description: A strict version 1 schema for a report recorded before Git-backed records, preserving its declared report fields, checks, and media provenance. It omits old-store paths, commands, and logs; revision and each media file's SHA-256 and byte count are nullable, while mediaType, capturedAt, and viewport are optional.
